policy: Fixed engineering targets before new measurement. Failure remains failure; profile revisions invalidate prior acceptance. No hardware has yet passed these profiles.

interactive.latency_budget: profile interactive p95/p99 for user reads; freshness/recovery for background work
interactive.correctness: zero mismatches; complete expected values/counts/cursors, no stale resurrection, unknown stays unknown; independent persisted-output readback

query_budget.read_rows_max: 4 * physical rows in declared participating tables per sweep; point/page hydration <= 2 * qualifying index granules
query_budget.read_bytes_max: 4 * physical bytes of needed columns per sweep; page metadata hydration only for selected IDs

request_budget.provider_requests_max: 20 * scopes + 8 * resources + ceil(resources / page_size), before retries; tighter per-family fixture budgets also apply

interactive.resource_budget: profile limits including whole ClickHouse/Postgres/native process memory, disk bytes and IO, not sum of per-query maxima
interactive.throughput_budget: sustain profile arrivals with bounded queue age; recover full declared backlog after 2x arrivals for 15 minutes
interactive.evidence: retained plans, raw samples, source/fixture/schema/dependency/hardware identities and independent replay; missing or stale scenario is zero coverage
